caller_pre_assessment_opinion: The rendered Ready mark reads as a completion check in both consumers at both scales, with the panel showing through (no matte) and nearest sampling preserved. The only stylistic tension is that the Start control is an anti-aliased vector while the status family will be hard-pixel art; the brief preserves Start, so this is an accepted mixed treatment, not a defect of the sample. Pending the specialist's view, I lean toward adopting the sample as the family baseline for stroke weight, flat single accent fill, binary-clean edges, transparent exterior and footprint, while not treating it as evidence of upstream PixelLab quality.
